entities.summary: Archana is an Indian actress who has worked in Kannada, Telugu, Tamil and Hindi films. She is known for her performances in such movies including Ee Hrudaya Ninagagi (1996), A (1998), Phool Aur Aag (1999) and Yajamana (2000).
